claimLedger.claim: Ovarian reserve equals oocyte quantity; markers test quantity not quality; should not be used as a fertility test for women with unproven fertility or as sole reason to deny ART
claimLedger.sourceSection: ASRM · Testing and interpreting measures of ovarian reserve: a committee opinion (2020) · Fertil Steril 2020;114:1151–7
claimLedger.limitations: US society opinion; assay cut-offs vary by laboratory

claimLedger.claim: Do not use AMH to predict clinical pregnancy through spontaneous conception; AMH/AFC may inform ovarian response counselling for assisted conception
claimLedger.sourceSection: NICE · NG257 investigation of fertility problems — ovarian reserve testing · Published 31 March 2026
claimLedger.limitations: UK guidance; Indian clinics may use AMH differently in local protocols

claimLedger.claim: Abnormal reserve tests suggest decline but do not identify who will or will not conceive; no single test definitively predicts ability to get pregnant
claimLedger.sourceSection: ReproductiveFacts.org / ASRM · Ovarian reserve (predicting fertility potential in women) · Revised 2023
claimLedger.limitations: Patient education sheet; not a treatment protocol
